thesis: Decentralization separates identity, private data, agent operation and routing to make exit credible.
role: Specify portable vaults, open semantics and accountable governance.

ideas.statement: Users can choose providers and routing without surrendering private intent; an open protocol carries semantic authority and disclosure states beyond transport standards.
Vaults separate evidence from corrigible inference and bind data to purpose; credentials and ledgers serve bounded roles rather than universal truth or permanent personal scoring.
Published governance, review, conformance and enforceable bans on paid rank support contestable power and switching.
